title: Fix private convolution fake symint handling
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #185081

torch._convolution has a SymInt schema, but fake tensor execution did not use the existing convolution fake/meta path. Under torch.compile(dynamic=True), aten._convolution fell through the generated composite wrapper into the int64_t native implementation, where ConvParams<int64_t> backend selection queried numel() on tensors with symbolic sizes and raised.

Register _convolution with the convolution FakeTensor implementation so symbolic execution uses the SymInt backend selector and memory-format logic. Add a small _convolution.default Meta kernel that reuses the existing convolution output shape logic. The deprecated 12-argument overload is included in the FakeTensor handler so the reported torch._convolution call is covered without converting every real backend call path to SymInt.

Fixes #165210

Generated by my agent

Test Plan:

- python test/test_fake_tensor.py -k test_private_convolution_symint

- direct 12-argument torch._convolution FakeTensor symbolic script

- torch.compile(model, backend='inductor', dynamic=True) repro

- torch.compile(model, backend='inductor', dynamic=True, mode='max-autotune') repro

- lintrunner -a
